proposals.note: Design incorporates a translation symmetry hypothesis (cyclic shift of sites 0->1->...->5->0) to regularize the ansatz, assuming the underlying data generation process is shift-invariant. The block consists of a linear chain of CNOTs interleaved with individual RY/RZ rotations (12 parameters), followed by a global RX rotation with a tied parameter (p12) applied to all qubits. This structure is invariant under the cyclic permutation of qubits if the parameters p0..p11 are permuted accordingly. The tied global rotation further enforces symmetry. This approach balances expressivity with structural bias, aiming to reduce overfitting and improve generalization on the regression task.
